camel_example: aliyun ecs ModifyReservedInstances --region cn-hangzhou --Configuration.1.Scope Zone --Configuration.1.ReservedInstanceName testReservedInstanceName --ReservedInstanceId.1 'ecsri-bp15xx20000' --Configuration.1.InstanceAmount 1 --Configuration.1.InstanceType 'ecs.c5.4xlarge' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Configuration.1.ZoneId 'cn-hangzhou-i'
description_en: Modifies the configurations of a reserved instance, such as the instance type, quantity, and zone, to split, merge, or change the scope of the reserved instance
description_zh: 本接口的主要功能是通过修改实例规格、数量、可用区等预留实例券的配置来对预留实例券进行拆分、合并或范围变更操作
kebab_example: aliyun ecs modify-reserved-instances --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --reserved-instance-id ecsri-bp15xx20000 --configuration InstanceAmount=1 ZoneId=cn-hangzhou-i Scope=Zone ReservedInstanceName=testReservedInstanceName InstanceType=ecs.c5.4xlarge --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyReservedInstances

element_fields.description_en:
The name of the new reserved instance.

The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length. The name must start with a letter and cannot start with http\:// or https\://. The name can contain letters, digits, colons (:), underscores (\_), and hyphens (-).
element_fields.description_zh:
预留实例券的名称。

长度为2~128个英文或中文字符。必须以大小写字母或中文开头，不能以http://和https://开头。可以包含数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）或者短划线（-）。
